artifacts.summary: All 7 phases completed: session-scoped both orchestration singletons, per-file differentiated read-time session_id verification, deleted dead handoff docs, widened tracking/gitignore machinery, added mtime-based reap wired into /refresh, proved with a 6-case test suite, deployed and verified.

completion_data.completion_summary: Session-scoped specs/.orchestrator-multi-state.json and specs/.return-meta-multi.json with a {session_id} suffix at every writer/reader, added hard-fail read-time session_id verification for the multi-state file and observational-only tracking for the loop guard/churn state (preserving multi-turn /orchestrate resume), deleted dead handoff documentation, widened tracking/gitignore machinery, added an mtime-based reap script wired into /refresh Step 4.5, and proved all of it with a 6-case isolated-temp-root test suite. All 7 phases completed and verified against the deployed .claude/ tree.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan requires an isolated-temp-root test suite for a shell script that reaps/sweeps files, model it on scripts/test-task-lock-reap.sh: copy the script under test byte-for-byte into a $TMPROOT/.claude/scripts/ fixture (so production code never learns it's under test), build a fixture specs/ tree with controlled epoch-arithmetic mtimes (touch -d "@$epoch", never real sleeping), and use the same pass/fail counter + exit-0-on-all-pass contract. This pattern generalizes cleanly to any new mtime-based reap script in this codebase.

deploy-headless.sh does not re-run copy_scripts/copy_manifest for an already-loaded extension, so a brand-new script file AND a manifest.json provides.scripts array update can both silently fail to propagate to .claude/ on redeploy -- even after running deploy-headless.sh. Verified empirically: two new scripts plus a manifest.json edit all needed a direct one-off file copy workaround. This is a third empirical instance of the gap already documented in .claude/rules/no-task-references-in-deliverables.md's "Discovered deploy-mechanism gap" section.
